scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/frontend-student" "npm run dev -w packages/frontend-admin" "npm run dev -w packages/backend"
scripts.dev:student: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/frontend-student" "npm run dev -w packages/backend"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/frontend-admin"  "npm run dev -w packages/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend-student && npm run build -w packages/frontend-admin
scripts.build:student: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/frontend-student
scripts.build:admin: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/frontend-admin
